description.value: A 40-acre private campground near Nanaimo with tenting options, renovated flush washrooms, showers, and a short rainforest trail to a Nanaimo River swimming hole; conveniently located minutes from both ferry terminals, making it a practical island transition stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms this is a 40-acre campground/RV park on Vancouver Island offering tenting, RV, glamping, and cabin sites. Showers confirmed via 'newly renovated bathrooms, warm showers'; laundry confirmed via 'on-site laundromat' and 'Laundry room'; on-site convenience store confirms food nearby; online booking system with 'BOOK NOW' button confirms reservations. Phone (250-245-1169) and address (1092 Spruston Road) match between OSM and website. No specific hiker/biker sites or cyclist-oriented amenities mentioned.
concerns: OSM name is 'Mountainaire Campground' but website consistently uses 'Mountainaire Campground and RV Park'
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, year-round campground with tenting sites, showers, laundry, and an on-site store — practical for touring cyclists. Well-positioned near ferry terminals for Vancouver Island routes.

wow_evidence: short rainforest trail to a Nanaimo River swimming hole; conveniently located minutes from both ferry terminals
